{{Quote|Well, we'll need a new Keshiri bearer for the ward-room.''"<br />"''What happened to the last one, Orlenda? Did you finally kill him with your kindnesses?''"<br />"''No. He's dead.|Orlenda and Seelah Korsin|<ref name="paragon" />}}
'''Orlenda''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Orlenda worked as an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Seelah Korsin]], [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of Lost Tribe [[Grand Lord]] [[Yaru Korsin]], in the [[Medcenter/Legends|sick wards]] that Korsin ran, and the two became good friends. Orlenda began a relationship with a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] laborer named [[Gorem]] around that [[Time/Legends|time]], which ended with his [[Death/Legends|death]] in a work accident.

In [[4975 BBY]], Orlenda was [[Reproduction/Legends|pregnant]], and she supported her friend Korsin in her [[Duel near the Kesh Sith Temple|plot]] to overthrow her [[Korsin family|husband]], Yaru. Although she could not take an active role in Korsin's planned uprising that would put her son, [[Jariad Korsin|Jariad]], on the [[Throne/Legends|throne]], Orlenda was meant to ensure that Korsin's policy of [[Speciesism|Human purity]] for the Lost Tribe would continue if anything went awry.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Go. But hurry. They're arriving.|Seelah Korsin, to Orlenda, before her coup attempt|<ref name="savior" />}}
[[File:Lost_Sith_Tribe_world.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Kesh, Orlenda's homeworld]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="paragon" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]],<ref name="savior" /> Orlenda was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]],<ref name="paragon" /> a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] group that, in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], crashed on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] and established dominion over the world's [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Homeworld/Legends|natives]].<ref name="Precipice">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref> Kesh having become her home, in [[4985 BBY]] Orlenda worked as the [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Seelah Korsin]], [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of Lost Tribe [[Grand Lord]] [[Yaru Korsin]] and head of the group's [[Medcenter/Legends|sick wards]]. In that capacity, Orlenda helped Korsin in her efforts to assure the [[Speciesism|Human purity]] and [[Gene/Legends|genetic]] perfection of future generations of Sith on Kesh, which included gathering Human [[Youngling/Legends|children]] and bringing them to Korsin for examinations. Orlenda began a relationship with a Keshiri laborer named [[Gorem]] around that [[Time/Legends|time]]. Her flirtation with Gorem ended when he suddenly [[Death/Legends|died]] while working at the crash site of the ''[[Omen]]'', the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that originally brought the Lost Tribe to Kesh. Saddened by his death, Orlenda was present at Gorem's [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] and the tossing of his body over a cliff.<ref name="paragon" />

That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], as part of their Human purity aspirations, Orlenda joined Seelah Korsin to inspect the genetic purity of Human youngling [[Ebya T'dell]], introducing the child to Korsin and providing general information about T'dell. After inspecting T'dell and expressing concerns about her appearance to Orlenda, Korsin declined Orlenda's offer to inspect other younglings on their list. Orlenda then revealed that the ward-room would need a new Keshiri bearer, explaining the circumstances of Gorem's death and funeral.<ref name="paragon" />

By [[4975 BBY]], Orlenda had become aware of Seelah's plan to overthrow her [[Korsin family|husband]], Yaru, and pave the way for her [[Reproduction/Legends|son]], [[Jariad Korsin|Jariad]], to become Grand Lord. Then pregnant, Orlenda was not able to actively participate but was chosen by Korsin to make sure her policies lived on if her coup attempt went awry. That year, immediately before Seelah planned to [[Duel near the Kesh Sith Temple|ambush]] Yaru, Orlenda was present with Jariad and a group of [[Sith Saber]] warriors near the [[Kesh Sith Temple]] in the [[Takara Mountains]]. Although Korsin briefly considered allowing Orlenda to stay by her side, she instead sent her down the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] with a [[cart]] of supplies bound for the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]]. In the end, although Yaru died in the ensuing battle, Seelah's plot was foiled, and Yaru's daughter, [[Nida Korsin|Nida]], took the [[Throne/Legends|throne]].<ref name="savior" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Gorem was, well, you remember, so ''strong''&mdash;|Orlenda, to Seelah Korsin|<ref name="paragon" />}}
Orlenda was attracted to the Keshiri worker Gorem. She was in awe of Gorem's physical strength and was saddened by his death. Orlenda had a friendly relationship with Seelah Korsin, who considered Orlenda hedonistic and lusty and enjoyed ribbing Orlenda about it.<ref name="paragon" /> In 4975 BBY, Orlenda and Korsin were close enough that the aide fully supported Korsin's power grab, and she was willing to stay by Korsin's for the battle.<ref name="savior" /> Possessed of a willowy figure, Orlenda had straight, [[Color/Legends|flaxen]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="paragon" />

==Equipment==
Orlenda used a piece of [[Paper/Legends|parchment]] to keep track of information on Human children living on Kesh.<ref name="paragon" />

==Behind the scenes==
Orlenda first appeared in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[2010]] [[eBook]] ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]'', the third installment of Miller's nine-part [[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith|''Lost Tribe of the Sith'']] series.<ref name="paragon" />
